name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Ordering system for food trucks
promotionalText: Accept pre-orders, protect the kitchen against too many orders and keep serving when the connection drops out. Ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is an ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team uses to keep service running.

Customers order in advance and choose a time to collect. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook and then mark the orders ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T STAND BY
Set how much the kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Record orders that come in at the food truck on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to make now, what comes next and what is ready, and lets you know when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a receipt printer in the kitchen with Bluetooth or over the local network and the order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE CONNECTION DROPS OUT
Switch on protection without an internet connection: if the connection breaks, pre-orders are put on hold, so nobody can place an order you don’t see. Orders you take on the device are kept and synced when the connection is restored.

BUILT FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up events and locations once and take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
whatsNew:
